allowed_origins.title: Allowed origins
allowed_origins.description: Origins this Plugin may fetch, such as https://example.com. Use normalized origins without paths, sorted in ascending order with no duplicates. An empty list blocks all requests; redirects are not followed.

max_response_bytes.title: Response size limit (bytes)
max_response_bytes.description: Maximum response body size, from 1 to 1,048,576 bytes (1 MiB).

timeout_ms.title: Request timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: Maximum request duration, from 1 to 30,000 milliseconds.
